_note: The overrun military outpost (Session 17, M9.4; DESIGN.md 'Overrun military outpost'; encounters/Outpost.js, render/OutpostProps.js). Positions are metres in the outpost's frame (Outpost.frame: facing the checkpoint from the clearing's centre, so z runs south toward the cordon, x to your right as you face it: west; the clearing's centre at 0, 0, the cordon at z 30). yaw: degrees from ahead (south) toward the right (west). The road comes in from the north-west (the gas station) and runs due south down x 0 from the centre to the checkpoint; the cemetery path comes in from the east (x negative) to the centre. barricade: the sandbag line across the clearing at z, from x0 to x1 in pieces: sandbags (solid to everyone), fence (the station's steel fence reused: solid but for the breach, a torn panel flat on the ground), rubble (spilled bags: open); the road's gap is between pieces, half blocked by the jackknifed truck (trucks[0], a vehicles.json car with a sure battery). lights: dead floodlight poles. firstHelmet: where the first army zombie stands on the road, looking up it. tower: the watchtower on the near side (x, z its centre; height its platform; half the platform's half size; legs the legs' half spread; the ladder on its north side). staging: what the soldiers left on the near side (gunPit: a sandbag ring; halt: the HALT sign; gear: dropped helmets, packs, rifles and ammo cans [x, z, kind, yaw]). compound: beyond the barricade: tents (x, z, w across, d along; the door faces the road), comms (the comms hut: open on its road side), armoury (the locker row, facing the road), containers on their flatbeds (yaw 90: the doors face west, the road; -90: east; kind: empty (doors blown outward), resin (the frozen alien), mothman (torn apart from inside), sealed (beetles scratching)), crates (the beetles' crates, [x, z, yaw]), manifest (the clipboard on its stand). searches: hold-X spots (gives: sure; loot: rolled with data/loot.json's items; the rest are beats in code). peak: where the barricade wave stands up, in the compound.
